surfaced.subject: revert: "websocket: pre-calculated length" (#3290)
surfaced.description: The change replaced Buffer.concat(this.#fragments) with a running #fragmentsBytes counter, but only incremented the counter in the uncompressed branch. Under permessage-deflate the counter stayed 0, so every compressed WebSocket message was delivered as an empty buffer. The revert body says it 'broke permessage-deflate support' and links nodejs/undici#3289 for why the tests did not catch it.
